title: Marlowe Rewards Share of Instant Exchange Holds
content:
Marlowe Rewards members carry a smaller card hold on a Returns & Exchanges Instant Exchange. The member share follows the cardholder's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active.

| Cardholder's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active | Share of the replacement value held |
|---|---|
| Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 0.5 (half) |
| Silver or Gold | 0.9 |
| Anyone else (Member tier, or no active membership) | The full value |

The share applies to the replacement value only; the sales tax on the hold remains worked out on the full replacement value.

Examples (hypothetical, replacement value 200.00):

- Icon member: 100.00 of the value held.
- Silver member: 180.00.
- Member tier, or a suspended membership: 200.00.
